import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

def grid_from_sparse(h,w,bg,cells):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r,c),v in cells.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g

def add_expected(g, cells):
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (r,c),v in cells.items(): o[r][c]=v
    return o

demos=[]
demos.append((grid_from_sparse(10,19,5,{(0,3):3,(0,6):0,(1,4):3,(1,5):0,(2,4):7,(2,5):2,(3,3):7}), {(4,2):7,(5,1):7,(6,0):7}))
c2={(0,20):5,(0,23):1,(1,21):5,(1,22):1,(2,21):4,(2,22):5,(3,20):4,(3,23):5}
c2.update({(r,23):5 for r in []})
# actual r3 c23=5, as above
adds2={(r,23-r):4 for r in range(4,24)}
demos.append((grid_from_sparse(29,24,0,c2),adds2))
demos.append((grid_from_sparse(10,27,1,{(0,14):2,(0,15):5,(1,14):7,(1,15):7,(2,13):7}), {(r,15-r):7 for r in range(3,10)}))
demos.append((grid_from_sparse(21,18,0,{(10,14):8,(11,15):8,(11,16):5,(12,15):2,(12,16):6,(13,14):2,(13,17):6}), {(r, r+4):8 for r in range(10)} | {(r,27-r):2 for r in range(14,21)}))
for i,(g,adds) in enumerate(demos,1):
    expected=add_expected(g,adds)
    got=mod.transform(g)
    diff=[(r,c,got[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if got[r][c]!=expected[r][c]]
    print(i, 'match', not diff, 'diff', diff[:15], 'n',len(diff))

test=[[1]*15 for _ in range(7)]
for (r,c),v in {(3,0):7,(4,1):7,(3,3):3,(4,2):3,(5,2):3,(5,1):4}.items(): test[r][c]=v
pred=mod.transform(test)
print('predicted non-background:', [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(pred) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=1])
